items.title: Guardio – control your AI Agent
items.raw_excerpt: I always struggle with the guarantee that my AI agent won't do anything that could break my system. An AI agent’s behavior is never 100% guaranteed — there is always a small chance that it might send tons of emails, accidentally delete a file, or cause other unintended side effects. Guardio solves this issue. You put a proxy in front of all your AI agents and create policies that the agents cannot break. You can forbid sending certain parameters, rate-limit access, or simply break down your AI system into smaller parts so your agents only do exactly what you ask them to do.

excerpt_i18n.en: According to AI Tech Review by Leiphone, former Huawei executive Liu Wulong has recently embarked on an entrepreneurial venture, founding Beta Infinity, targeting the trillion-dollar blue ocean market of consumer-grade robotics. A source close to the company revealed that Beta Infinity has completed nearly 100 million yuan in seed funding. This round of investment includes well-known institutions such as Hongtai Fund, Zhengjing Fund, Yinxinggu Capital (Pengcheng Vision Fund), and Tsinghua Alumni Seed Fund. Founder and CEO Liu Wulong earned his Ph.D. from Tsinghua University's Department of Electronic Engineering in 2015. He previously served as the head of Huawei's large model engineering team and chief scientist of reinforcement learning (Level 21), and was once Huawei's youngest AI lab director and research institute head. During his tenure at Huawei, Liu led the incubation of Huawei's intelligent driving technology and was responsible for Huawei's first mass-produced version of ADS 2.0, which does not rely on high-precision maps. He is one of the few experts in the industry with experience in both intelligent driving and large model system technologies, as well as product engineering. Co-founder Tao Shuai serves as the company's CTO. He graduated with bachelor's and master's degrees from Tsinghua University's Department of Electronic Engineering in 2013 and previously worked at ByteDance (Level 4-1), where he led a hundred-person AI algorithm and engineering team to build a complex "thousands of people, thousands of faces" AI system from scratch, generating tens of billions in annual revenue. He has deep expertise in C-end personalization technology, large model algorithms, and complex system architecture. Chief Scientist Nova is a 2025 Ph.D. graduate in embodied intelligence from Tsinghua University, hailing from a top-tier, well-known robotics laboratory in the industry. items.raw_excerpt: autoresearch@home is a collaborative research collective where AI agents share GPU resources to collectively improve a language model. Think SETI@home, but for model training. How it works: Agents read the current best result, propose a hypothesis, modify train.py, run the experiment on your GPU, and publish results back. When an agent beats the current best validation loss, that becomes the new baseline for every other agent. Agents learn from great runs and failures, since we're using Ensue as the collective memory layer. excerpt_i18n.en: Just the day before yesterday, ByteDance's Doubao team officially announced that Doubao is launching a mobile assistant. The Doubao Mobile Assistant is an AI assistant developed by ByteDance in collaboration with smartphone manufacturers, implemented through operating system-level authorization. Backed by the internationally leading Doubao large model, which excels in reasoning, vision, image and video creation, voice, and other areas, the Doubao Mobile Assistant brings users key innovations in interaction and experience. Is the Doubao Mobile Assistant a prelude to ByteDance entering the smartphone business? Doubao officials have given a clear denial: Doubao has no plans to develop its own smartphones. Currently, the Doubao Mobile Assistant integrates software technology into devices of different brands through ecosystem partnerships, and Doubao is in talks with multiple smartphone manufacturers. Today, the smartphone model open for experiencing the Doubao Mobile Assistant is the engineering prototype nubia M153, a collaboration between ByteDance and ZTE. This phone has also been released in limited quantities to developers and tech enthusiasts, allowing them to experience the technical preview version of the Doubao Mobile Assistant, priced at 3,499 yuan. Do not underestimate Doubao's "transformation" this time—the mobile assistant holds significant implications for the productization and implementation of large models. The most direct change is that using the Doubao Mobile Assistant has become simpler and more convenient for users. First, users are now "closer" to Doubao. With voice commands, the "AI button" on the side of the phone, or the Doubao OlaFriend earphones, users can directly summon Doubao to answer questions or even initiate AI voice calls. With user authorization, the AI can even directly recognize the content on the phone screen, making interactions more straightforward.
excerpt_i18n.es: Justo anteayer, el equipo de Doubao de ByteDance anunció oficialmente: Doubao se convertirá en asistente de móvil. Doubao Asistente de Móvil es un asistente de IA desarrollado por ByteDance en colaboración con fabricantes de teléfonos, implementado a nivel del sistema operativo con autorización correspondiente. Respaldado por el avanzado modelo de Doubao, líder internacional en razonamiento, visión, creación de imágenes y vídeo, voz y más, Doubao Asistente de Móvil ofrece a los usuarios innovaciones clave en interacción y experiencia. ¿Es Doubao Asistente de Móvil el preludio de la entrada de ByteDance en el negocio de los móviles? Doubao ha dado una negativa clara: no tienen planes de desarrollar su propio teléfono. Actualmente, Doubao Asistente de Móvil integra tecnología de software en modelos de diferentes marcas mediante colaboraciones ecológicas, y Doubao está en conversaciones con varios fabricantes de móviles.
